queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Arua City Physical Planning and Housing Department, which lists land registration and cadastral-job/map functions, and the Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development UgNLIS pages, which identify Arua as a Ministry Zonal Office. officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Arua City Physical Planning and Housing Department is evidenced by its official city page. It lists land registration, urban planning, subdivision, cadastral-job quality checks, city surveying and mapping responsibilities.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalCadastreAuthority: Uganda Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development (MLHUD), including the Department of Surveys and Mapping and UgNLIS.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: Arua City directly documents land-registration and cadastral/mapping functions, while the official MLHUD UgNLIS page lists Arua among the 22 Ministry Zonal Offices. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery, not adapter qualification or citywide geometry coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: A first-party local city land/planning custodian and a first-party national land-information system with an Arua MZO were evidenced. No anonymous parcel geometry was retained.

schemaAndCrs.responseType: JSON API routes exposed by current portal JavaScript; metadata routes returned JSON, with boundary route returning HTTP 500
schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: The portal HTML loaded main.8123d6213976b174.js.
